name: phoneinfoga
install: official sundowndev/phoneinfoga container (REST mode) or a release binary
network: outbound HTTP(S); in local mode no request is sent at all
review_notes: Go binary: verify the release checksum before installing (see docs/PLUGINS.md).
The numverify/ovh scanners need keys configured ON the PhoneInfoga container, never inside ReconCore.
REST mode is preferred: the third-party binary stays in its own container.
The REST API expects digits only; the plugin strips '+' and separators before calling it.
Local mode sends no request: it only proposes searches.
